newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian GDP rose provisional 0.5 pct in Q4 96.
newsitem.headline: Italian GDP rose provisional 0.5 pct in Q4 96.

text.p: Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by a provisional 0.5 percent, year-on-year, in the fourth quarter of 1996, National Statistics Institute Istat said.
Note: Final GDP data for the fourth quarter will be given on April 14 by ISTAT, however the figures are expected to be released in parliament some time in March.
ISTAT said the provisional fourth quarter data pointed to GDP growth of 0.8 percent in 1996 compared with 1995.
The 1996 fourth quarter contained two fewer working days than the third quarter but there were two more working days than in the fourth quarter of 1995, the institute said.
ISTAT officials said industrial output fell in the fourth quarter over the third quarter but activity in the services sector rose slightly.
They said exports were worse than expected, though did not specify over which quarter. Imports were sharply down year on year in the fourth quarter but up on the previous quarter.
